events.label: Jane Doe alleges sexual assault at Cornell fraternity

slots.name: Snapchat members
slots.sentence: A person, Male 6, told campus police investigators that about 50 fraternity members were on that particular Snapchat thread.

slots.name: rape confidence
slots.sentence: Cornell University has said its police department shared the victim's sworn six-page statement and a screenshot of the Snapchat thread with the DA's office.

slots.name: apology messages
slots.sentence: She also told campus investigators that three men from that night, including Male 1 and Male 2, had sent her text messages apologizing.

slots.name: sworn statement pages
slots.sentence: Another person, Male 7, told police investigators the first Snapchat message in the chain was sent by Male 1.

slots.name: accused brothers
slots.sentence: after outrage sparked this week about an alleged gang rape incident in 2024 by seven brothers of the Chi Phi fraternity at the Ivy League university.

slots.name: start date
slots.sentence: a former Cornell University student who alleged in a lawsuit last month that she was raped, sexually assaulted and plied with drugs by members of Chi Phi fraternity in 2024.

slots.name: snapchat message time
slots.sentence: At 1:42 a.m. on Oct. 20, 2024, according to the lawsuit she filed, a message was sent in the fraternity's Snapchat group suggesting that a woman was available in the frat house for sex.

slots.name: end time
slots.sentence: According to her lawsuit, Jane Doe alleges the sexual assaults continued until she lost consciousness at about 5:45 a.m.

slots.name: Cornell Health appointment date
slots.sentence: Jane Doe told campus investigators that two days after the incident, on Oct. 22, she made an appointment at Cornell Health.

slots.name: graduation status
slots.sentence: Jane Doe eventually left Cornell without graduating.

slots.name: fraternity status
slots.sentence: The university later shut down the Cornell chapter of the Chi Pi fraternity.

slots.name: police report date
slots.sentence: The student made a report to Cornell police about three weeks after the incident she alleges,
